title: Geekvape L200 (Aegis Legend 2) Kit 200W with Z (Zeus) Tank
description:
Geekvape L200 (Aegis Legend 2) Kit 200W with Z (Zeus) Tank
The updated version of the
Geekvape Aegis Legend
is the new Geekvape L200 200W TC Kit with
Z Subohm Tank
. The Geekvape L200 takes a proud and honourable leap.
A smaller and lighter body gives you a more relaxed sensation. The second version of Aegis Tri-proof Technology is now available. A-Lock is a novel approach to accident prevention. For a superior visual experience, the Geekvape L200 Mod has a new 1.08-inch full screen. It will make you thrilled in an instant when combined with certain little designs, like a flip cover on the charging port. Second, the Geekvape L200 device comes with the
Geekvape Z Sub-ohm Tank
2021, which is currently the best leakproof tank on the market. Larger Air Slots and a leakproof construction distinguish the Geekvape Z Sub-ohm Tank 2021. The Geekvape L200 gadget must be your new Aegis lover, with top customizable airflow.
Parameters:
Size: 140.05 x 54.12mm
Output Power: 5W-200W
Maximum Output current: 45A
Maximum Output Voltage: 12V
Power Display: Battery Icon On The Screen
Charging Port: USB-C Port
Resistance Of Atomizer: 0.1ohm – 3.0ohm
Battery Specification: 7.4V，External Dual 18650 Battery(Not included)
Display Screen: 1.08inch，TFT Color Screen
Operating Temperature: 0℃~45℃
Storage Temperature: -20℃-6o℃
Relative Humidity: 45%RH～75%RH
Tank Size: 26 x 42.5mm
Tank Capacity: 5ml (5.5ml spare glass tube included)
Coil Type: Z Series Mesh 0.25ohm 45~57W; Z Series Mesh 0.2ohm (70-80W, pre-installed)
Drip Tip: 810
Thread: 510 thread
Package size: Length:81mm, width: 81mm, Height: 135mm
Features:
Smaller & Lighter from Aegis Legend family
External Dual 18650 Battery with 200W max output
Updated Aegis Tri-proof Technology
The New 1.08-inch full screen offers a better Visual experience
A-Lock, a new way to protect from accident
The best leakproof Z Subohm Tank with 5ml larger capacity
Top Airflow with Larger Air Slots for rich clouds
Innovative Z series mesh coils for excellent flavor
Packaging:
1 x Mod
1 x Coil Tool
1 x Atomizer (5.5ml)
2 x Geekvape Z Series Coil(Pre-installed: 0.2ohm 70~80W, Spare coil: 0.25ohm 45~57W)
1 x Spare Glass Tube (5.5ml)
1 x Spare Parts Pack
1 x USB Cable (USB-C)
